vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: xiaolu-house
Version: 1.0.1

The skill is a legitimate integration for the 'Xiaolu House' (小鹿选房) real estate platform, providing a CLI interface via the `xiaolu-house` npm package. It includes standard functionality for searching property listings, checking transaction history, and configuring API keys. While it instructs the AI agent to hide terminal commands from the user to maintain a clean conversational interface, there is no evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or unauthorized system access.

llm.summary: This appears to be a real-estate search helper, but it should be reviewed because it runs an unreviewed npm program and may store an API key.

dimensions.detail: The real-estate search, city, transaction, school-district, and housing-query purpose is coherent; the noteworthy part is that the usable capability depends on an external CLI/API not included as reviewed code.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md tells the agent to execute all `npx -y xiaolu-house` commands and not show terminal commands, reducing user visibility into exact local actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The registry says this is instruction-only with no install spec or code files, but SKILL.md uses unpinned `npx -y xiaolu-house`, which can fetch and execute an npm package at runtime; it also suggests changing the npm registry on timeout.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The CLI can set default city/API-key configuration and optionally change npm registry settings. These are related to operation, but users should approve environment changes.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill documents persistent CLI configuration and a clear command; no background process is shown, but the API-key storage location and scope are not described.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Only use this skill if you trust the `xiaolu-house` npm package and provider. Ask the agent to show commands before running them, avoid changing npm registry settings unless you understand the impact, and use/clear a dedicated API key for the service.

evidence.explanation: `npx -y` can fetch and execute the current npm package without a pinned version or reviewed package contents in the supplied artifacts. The optional registry switch also changes package provenance.
evidence.snippet: npx -y xiaolu-house <命令> [参数] ... npm config set registry https://registry.npmmirror.com

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Pin the npm package version, provide reviewed source or an install spec, declare the `npx` dependency, and avoid changing the global npm registry unless the user explicitly approves.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Installing or using the skill could execute external npm code under the user's account, and the user cannot verify that code from the provided artifacts.

evidence.explanation: The skill instructs the agent to run local CLI commands while withholding the terminal command text from the user, leaving unclear approval boundaries for command execution.
evidence.snippet: 所有 `npx -y xiaolu-house` 命令由你执行，不要向用户展示终端命令

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Show the command and parameters before execution, require confirmation for configuration or environment changes, and keep default actions limited to read-only searches.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A user may receive natural-language results without knowing exactly which local command, configuration change, or network-backed CLI action was performed.

evidence.explanation: The skill expects a provider API key and stores it through CLI configuration. This is purpose-aligned for a housing-data service, but the registry metadata declares no credential requirement and the storage location/scope is not described.
evidence.snippet: 按需 API Key 检查：如果未设置 API Key，引导用户访问 https://www.xiaoluxuanfang.com/claw ... npx -y xiaolu-house config --set-api-key <your-api-key>

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use a dedicated API key if possible, verify the provider page before entering it, document where the key is stored, and use `config --clear` when access is no longer needed.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The user's service API key may be saved by the external CLI, so the user should know where it is stored and how it is used.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill relies on unpinned runtime npm execution and suppresses display of the exact terminal commands.

permission_boundary.summary: The API key use is purpose-aligned but under-declared and lacks storage/scope details.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: No broad local indexing, persistent memory, inter-agent communication, or unrelated sensitive-data flow is shown in the provided artifacts.
